title: The closure of an irreducible subset is irreducible
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space and let $T\subseteq X$ be an irreducible subset [def-weil-irreducible-components] (nonempty, and not the union of two proper closed subsets in the subspace topology). Then the closure $\overline T$ of $T$ in $X$ is irreducible.
